blocks.title: Testing
blocks.text: Software ban jane ke baad us ki testing hoti hai: software ko jaanchna ta ke koi bugs, ghaltiyan ya masail pehchane ja sakein. Yeh maiyar ki jaanch hai ke sab kuch tawaqqo ke mutabiq kaam kare; software ko mukhtalif halaat mein chala kar dekha jata hai ke theek rawayya rakhta hai ya nahi.

items: Functionality testing: tamam features tafseelat ke mutabiq kaam karti hain.
Performance testing: software mukhtalif halaat, jaise zyada traffic ya bhaari data, mein acha kaam karta hai.
Compatibility testing: software mukhtalif devices aur operating systems par theek chalta hai.

blocks.text: Testing chhupe hue masail pehchanne mein madad deti hai jo development ke doran nazar nahi aaye. Unhein theek kar ke developers yaqeeni banate hain ke software hamwari se chale aur user ki zarooratein poori kare, aur behtar aur qabil-e-aitbar tajruba de.

blocks.prompt: Bataiye ke SDLC mein testing ka marhala kyun aham hai aur do wajahein dijiye (short question 2).
blocks.explanation: Testing bugs aur chhupe masail users tak pohanchne se pehle dhoondti hai, aur tasdeeq karti hai ke software tafseelat poori kare, bojh mein kaam kare aur mukhtalif devices par chale; is marhale par masail theek karna release ke baad se sasta hai aur users ko qabil-e-aitbar product milta hai.

items: Testing: bane hue software ko mukhtalif halaat mein bugs, ghaltiyon aur masail ke liye jaanchna.
Yahan aqsam: functionality, performance aur compatibility testing; yeh chhupe masail dhoondti aur software ko qabil-e-aitbar banati hai.
